entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: An influential black-aligned organization on Otaria that worshipped money and Kuberr, and later became a demonic death cult under Belzenlok.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The place on Dominaria where the Cabal was founded.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane the Cabal later spread across.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: The numen the early Cabal worshipped; he reincarnated and took over the Cabal after the Patriarch's death.

entities.name: Virot Maglan
entities.description: The Cabal's founder and head, who alone knew everyone's secret name.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A demonlord summoned through the Cabal's spell who replaced Kuberr as their god and restored the Cabal's power.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A former Cabal member summoned back to lead the cult after Belzenlok's death.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: The figure who destroyed Cabal City.

entities.name: Lagomos
entities.description: Maintained the Cabal after Belzenlok's death until Braids was summoned.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: A Cabal figure who was gone by the end of Karona's War.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: The capital of the Cabal and residence of the Patriarch, later destroyed and turned into a refugee camp.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: The Cabal's second major city in the south, which became its new center after Cabal City's destruction.

entities.name: Grand Coliseum
entities.description: The site of the Cabal's third city and later main base, destroyed in Karona's War.

entities.name: Stronghold of Urborg
entities.description: The new capital of the Cabal under Belzenlok.

entities.name: The Order
entities.description: The Cabal's most persistent enemies, who found its exploitative nature morally despicable.

entities.name: Karona's War
entities.description: The war after which Aphetto and the Grand Coliseum were destroyed and the Cabal lost its leaders.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: The event after which black mana flowed back and the Cabal resurged.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion whose aftermath grew the popularity of the Cabal's pit fights.

entities.name: Weatherlight crew
entities.description: The crew that helped slay Belzenlok.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group that helped slay Belzenlok.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A professional gladiator who fought in the Cabal's pits.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: A professional gladiator who fought in the Cabal's pits.

events.summary: Virot Maglan founds the Cabal in the wake of the collapse of Suderbod, focused on commerce.
events.quote: The Cabal was founded by Virot Maglan in 4050 AR

events.summary: After the Phyrexian Invasion the Cabal's pit fights grow in popularity, greatly expanding its wealth and influence.
events.quote: resulting in a major expansion in the wealth and influence of the Cabal

events.summary: Chainer destroys Cabal City after the Patriarch's exile to Aphetto, which becomes the new center of the Cabal.
events.quote: the Patriarch's exile to Aphetto and Cabal City's subsequent destruction by Chainer

events.summary: The reincarnated Kuberr takes over the Cabal after the Patriarch's death.
events.quote: The reincarnated Kuberr took over the Cabal after the Patriarch's death.

events.summary: After Karona's War the Cabal is left with no leader and no god and is presumed defunct around 4500 AR.
events.quote: the Cabal was left with no leader and no god

events.summary: After the Mending, a Cabal group's spell summons the demonlord Belzenlok, who maims the cabalists and demands they serve him instead of Kuberr.
events.quote: the demonlord Belzenlok burst forth from the rift from the Abyss it created

events.summary: Belzenlok restores the Cabal's power, shifting its capital to the Stronghold of Urborg and expanding across Dominaria as a death cult.
events.quote: the Cabal shifted their capital to the Stronghold of Urborg

events.summary: Belzenlok is slain by the Weatherlight crew and the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Belzenlok's reign was ended when he was slain by the joint efforts of the Weatherlight crew and the Gatewatch

events.summary: After Belzenlok's death Lagomos maintains the Cabal until members summon Braids to lead them.
events.quote: until its members summoned their former member Braids to lead them
